metaTitle: How to Choose RV Internet Hardware
description: Choose RV routers, hotspots and antennas by source, SIM count, MIMO antennas, power draw and failover, with data use tables and setups by travel style.
directAnswer: Pick sources first (cellular, campground WiFi, satellite), then a router with external antenna ports, 12 V power and automatic failover. Light users can tether a hotspot, while remote workers need a dual-SIM router with roof MIMO antennas.
